correctness.rationale: For reflexive Łukasiewicz-transitive R on arbitrary nonempty W, the row r_x(y)=R(x,y) is R-open; r_x^{⊙k}=max(0,1-k(1-R(x,y))) and its arbitrary infimum equals the indicator of the unit-cut principal upset S[x]. Constants and arbitrary joins reconstruct every S-upward fuzzy function, while τ_S is closed under the required operations, proving the equality. Necessity interior pointwise lies between the S-box and its lower clipping at 1-ρ; a valuation zero at one nonunit successor and one elsewhere yields the matching R(x,y) distortion. For a gap ρ<1, the least common row-power cutoff is ceil(1/(1-ρ)), floored at one. Countable star R(o,v_n)=1-1/n preserves the liminf obstruction under finite meets/joins/⊙ but not arbitrary infima. Independent two-world grid check gives 3/4 displacement and fourth-power cutoff; actual exact finite-grid checker source inspected.
